title: Soul Feast #2: Where Did the Inspiration for “The Seat of the Soul” Come From?
excerpt: ﻿ In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav delves into the inspiration behind his groundbreaking work, “The Seat of the Soul,” and the journey that led him to discover the deeper truths about the universe…
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav delves into the inspiration behind his groundbreaking work, “The Seat of the Soul,” and the journey that led him to discover the deeper truths about the universe and non-physical reality. 

He begins by sharing how the ideas for his work didn’t originate from him alone but were co-created with the universe, urging listeners to explore and find their own truth in every teaching. 

Gary invites us to examine how inspiration comes from beyond our physical senses and how our understanding of consciousness has expanded beyond the limitations of the five senses.

Gary provides insights into his personal experience with quantum physics, and how it became a gateway to a broader understanding of non-physical reality and co-creation. 

Through his storytelling, Gary explores how his writing journey was less about structure and more about allowing inspiration from the universe to flow through him, showing us how true creation is never done in isolation. 

He also recounts his transformative experiences meeting with non-physical entities and how these encounters deepened his awareness and connection to a larger reality beyond the physical world.

As you listen, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of how consciousness is evolving, the role of co-creation in our lives, and how embracing non-physical reality can lead to a richer, more expansive experience of life.

What We Discuss in This Episode:

  • (01:51) The inspiration behind “The Seat of the Soul” and how Gary’s work is co-created with the universe.
  • (02:34) The shift from old consciousness, rooted in the five senses, to a new consciousness that embraces a wider reality.
  • (05:52) Gary’s journey into quantum physics and how it led to a discovery of non-physical reality.
  • (09:55) Understanding co-creation and how it influences everything we do, including Gary’s writing process.
  • (18:25) Gary’s encounter with a non-physical entity and the life-changing impact it had on his journey.
